knobs.note: BH-6838: the full-trigger delta over catalog/ci-batch-escalate.tsv, projected by bin/ci-plan-settings.sh into the repo variable CI_FULL_TRIGGERS that bin/ci-plan.sh reads. Space-separated tokens: +<pattern> adds an escalate row, -<pattern> removes the escalate row with that exact pattern. A self row (the files that decide what a batch runs) cannot be removed, and a token with `..` or no sign is dropped. Empty = the committed rules. A value over 256 chars is refused (warn alert ci-plan-settings-projection:<slug>, the old variable stays).
